name: Valorant Tracker
author: PackRat
short_description: Turn Stream Deck into a physical VALORANT ranked dashboard for RR, automatic session progress and recent competitive stats.
description: Valorant Tracker puts the ranked information you actually check during a competitive session directly on Stream Deck. See current rank and RR, automatically track session wins, losses and net RR as Competitive results arrive, review recent performance, expand agent and map stats on larger decks, and keep a 45 second spike timer under your hand. Account setup is shared across every key, so Riot ID and HenrikDev API key are entered once. The plugin normally detects the account region automatically and keeps a selectable fallback region for edge cases. One shared cache and refresh service avoids duplicate requests for every visible key. Bundled dashboards are included for standard Stream Deck, Stream Deck XL and Stream Deck Neo and can be customized after installation.
highlights: Current competitive rank, RR and latest RR movement
Persistent automatic session RR plus win and loss record
Recent headshot percentage, damage and ACS
Top agent K/D and win rate with expandable slots
Top map win rate with expandable slots
Recent match views for larger dashboards
Advanced manual win and loss fallback with later API reconciliation
Automatic region detection with selectable fallback region
Bundled Standard, XL and Neo dashboard profiles
One shared account setup for every action
Five minute shared cache with last known good fallback and bounded network timeouts
requirements: Windows 10 or newer, or macOS 12 or newer
A Riot ID in Name#TAG format
A user provided HenrikDev API key
setup_summary: Install Valorant Tracker and open any action's Property Inspector
Open the HenrikDev dashboard, generate an API key and paste it once
Use the fallback region selector only when automatic region detection cannot resolve the account
Use the bundled dashboard for your Stream Deck model or arrange individual actions yourself
privacy: Riot ID, fallback region, HenrikDev API key, session state and cached player data are stored using Stream Deck settings on the user's computer. PackRat does not receive the API key or player data. Requests required for player statistics are sent to HenrikDev.
third_party: Requires a user provided HenrikDev API key. HenrikDev is an independent third party community API. Availability, endpoint behavior and rate limits are outside PackRat's control.
